record.question:
The constitutional office of the Governor has frequently emerged as a structural flashpoint in Centre-
    State relations. Which of the following statements accurately outlines the Governor’s powers?
      1. The Governor possesses constitutional discretion to reserve a Bill for the consideration of the
           President if it endangers the position of the State High Court.
      2. Under Article 356, the Governor’s report recommending the imposition of President’s Rule is
           a purely subjective document that cannot be subjected to judicial review by courts.
      3. The Governor can dismiss an active Ministry that enjoys an absolute, demonstrated majority
           on the floor of the Legislative Assembly based entirely on individual personal assessment.
